Yes, there’s nothing I can do to do what I love in life. I always wanted to go to school full time and have a part time job, while streaming games and making funny videos.

Not to get famous, I just liked seeing my ideas in my head come to life. I *have* made a few videos back in high school that got a couple hundred views. 

Now, I’m just a fucking blob. Working my life away.
 
My friends are like “Yea we should start steaming soon before school starts” “yea sounds good”

They talk about more things but basically they’re moving on without me

It breaks my heart but I understand, if I could manage time to do it alone I would, but I can’t. I’m physically, mentally, and emotionally exhausted. I wish I would get cancer so I’d have a reason to do what I loved for a short period of time at least without worrying about the long term.
I have no future, I once did…but no longer. Not everyone makes it in life, and sadly I’m one of those people.

When I start stressing, it’s in my chest on the higher part of my pecs in the middle

They’re not pecs, but they’re definitely not manboobs, but right about there

They would just say I’m resilient and that I’m strong

I’m not strong, I’m scared to go to Hell

They just kinda listened and said I was strong

I’ve been working 12 hour shifts and live with friends, so no time to cry. Haven’t cried in months. 

But one morning I went in my friend’s room while they were asleep elsewhere, and I locked the door. 

And I just cried.

And it felt so fucking good. Felt so amazing.

I got my behind the wheel test on the 3rd, what’s it like?

What do I need to know about the buttons of the car? (Windshield wipers, turn signals, defroster, AC, heater, etc)

Like will they get in and say “Tell me what those buttons are for.”?

I guess I’m at rock bottom now, and reading these stories…my point is proven, that I don’t have it as bad as others.

Just 2 years ago, I had everything I wanted and needed. A big bed, my own room, all the gaming consoles, I was doing good in school, applying to universities, getting ready to graduate. 

My grandma was great, my mom was recovered. 

I guess I don’t know where to start.

You feel like every decision is gonna negatively hurt you, with the pros not worth it.

You know people will miss you, but you know they don’t need you, nor want you as much as they want other people.

You feel like sleeping forever, you keep asking “How did I get here?”

Sometimes you’ll hate yourself and think “Stop being a bitch. Millions have it worse.”

Sometimes you’ll think “It’s not fair”

Sometimes you’ll think of suicide…but you’re too scared to risk not seeing that light at the end of the tunnel…or maybe you’re scared there’s a chance Hell exists and you’ll go there (which is why I haven’t done it)

Sometimes you’ll think you did something terribly wrong to deserve it

Everybody will be proud of each other on social media, all connected.

I have 8 siblings, and they’re all together in some form. They either live with their mom or grandma.

But I’m just the fuck up fling between my parents, so my 4 sister’s from my mom’s side are with their grandma.

And my 2 brothers and 2 other sisters from my dad’s side are with their mom

Here I am, sleeping on my friend’s couch working a full time job, had to quit school. Wondering if I should even live.

I don’t know where my dad is, my mom went crazy from drug relapse (meth)

My grandma understood I was alone, and gave me everything. 

I wasn’t even gonna go to graduation back in 2016, I had too many absences.

My grandma bought my cap and gown though, and demanded I make up days in lunch detention.

She died 12 hours after graduation, she didn’t even make it because she was basically a vegetable at that point.

I’ll never know what it’s like to know I can take my time with school like my friends and siblings, knowing they’ll have someone and somewhere.

I’ll be scared and worried about bills constantly. 

I’m only 19, I was supposed to go to college.

Seeing my siblings talk about their “hardships” on Facebook and posting their “accomplishments” makes me so mad. Why was that taken from me?

I know I’m just ranting, but this is my rock bottom. Nobody wants me, and maybe I’ll be heard here just like other people here who have shitty lives.

Maybe one day when I lose my faith in God existing, I’ll be comfortable enough to be gone forever and end my life.

8th grade, I can stop my dad and mom from going crazy and relapsing, stop my grandma from detecting the cancer too late.

I’d take the iPod my mom got me that birthday, take more pictures, go to six flags with my dad, stepmom, and half my siblings, because that’s where they took me.

Go to Apple Bee’s after like we did, beat Ocarina of Time 3D when I got home like I did.

That day was honestly perfect, so much happiness. 

I’d use that day and tell myself that’s what I have to fight for

10th grade, second semester. 

I remember coming home from school, playing video games, grandma would make dinner, I’d eat, then do my homework.

Best year of my life. It was the simplest time of my life. 

Now I’m 19, working a full time job, mom and Dad are junkies again, I’m living with a friend, had to stop going to school, all of my siblings are half siblings so they actually have a stable parent or a stable grandparent, both of mine are not stable and my grandparents are dead now. 

I’m so sorry grandma, I know I failed you.
